chAr: الدوال والقيمة المطلقة ونظرية المعادلات التربيعية
f_ar: تعريف 1.1 — Inverse الدوال و One-to-One Condition
b: A function \( f \) has an inverse \( f^{-1} \) if and only if \( f \) is a one-to-one (injective) mapping across its given domain. For any \( y = f(x) \), \( f^{-1}(y) = x \). The domain of \( f^{-1} \) equals the range of \( f \), and the range of \( f^{-1} \) equals the domain of \( f \). Graphically, \( y = f^{-1}(x) \) is the reflection of \( y = f(x) \) in the line \( y = x \).

f_ar: Theorem 2.1 — Remainder & Factor Theorems
b:
If a polynomial \( P(x) \) is divided by \( (ax - b) \), the remainder is \( R = P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right) \).
If \( P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right) = 0 \), then \( (ax - b) \) is an exact factor of \( P(x) \).

f: Deep Conceptual Intuition — Differentiation, Rules & Rates of Change
f_ar: الفهم المفاهيمي العميق — التفاضل وقواعد الاشتقاق ومعدلات التغير المرتبطة
b: Local Linearization & Differentiability: A function \(f\) is differentiable at \(x = a\) if and only if the difference quotient \(\lim_{h \to 0} \dfrac{f(a+h) - f(a)}{h}\) exists as a finite real number. Differentiability at \(x = a\) strictly implies continuity at \(x = a\), but the converse fails at sharp corners (e.g. \(|x - 3|\)), vertical tangents, or jump discontinuities.

f_ar: الفهم المفاهيمي العميق — التكامل والمساحات المستوية وعلم الحركة (الميكانيكا)
b: Accumulation, Antiderivatives & Differential Flows: By the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, the accumulation function \(A(x) = \int_a^x f(t)\,dt\) satisfies \(A'(x) = f(x)\), linking instantaneous rates of change to net signed area. In first-order differential equations \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = g(x)h(y)\), separation of variables \(\int \dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy = \int g(x)\,dx + C\) reconstructs the family of integral curves across the slope field.
